bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for a Trunk Highway 7 transportation management organization.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; TRUNK HIGHWAY 7 TRANSPORTATION MANAGEMENT ORGANIZATION. +]

[+(a) $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to the city of Shorewood to provide for a transportation management organization along the marked Trunk Highway 7 corridor from the western border of Hennepin County to marked Interstate Highway 494. This appropriation is available for the operational activities of a transportation management organization in the cities and school districts along this corridor and connecting roadways. This is a onetime appropriation. +]

[+(b) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, the commissioner must not use any amount of this appropriation for administrative costs. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for a Trunk Highway 7 transportation management organization.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; TRUNK HIGHWAY 7 TRANSPORTATION MANAGEMENT ORGANIZATION.

(a) $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to the city of Shorewood to provide for a transportation management organization along the marked Trunk Highway 7 corridor from the western border of Hennepin County to marked Interstate Highway 494. This appropriation is available for the operational activities of a transportation management organization in the cities and school districts along this corridor and connecting roadways. This is a onetime appropriation.

(b) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, the commissioner must not use any amount of this appropriation for administrative costs.

This appropriation is available for the operational activities of a transportation management organization in the cities and school districts along this corridor and connecting roadways. (b) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, the commissioner must not use any amount of this appropriation for administrative costs.
